evidence: PlaSim's clear-sky longwave as a copy of its arithmetic (which reproduces its own heating within 0.01 K a day on cloud-free 3-day means) with and without each correction the runner can add, against the atmosphere domain's correlated-k model on the same columns; both plane-parallel, without the curved air's escape. The states are GCM years, those near 301 K from a run still warming 1.5 K a year; correlated-k is the target, not line-by-line.
reading_rule: Errors are PlaSim (copy) less correlated-k in W/m2 by layer from the ground (negative cools too much) and in the outgoing longwave, means and rms over the columns of each group: plasim without a correction, and under each correction's name with it, scaled by (T / tref)^4 as the GCM scales it; fitted_on_these_columns marks the sample a correction was fitted on. cloud_free samples the columns clear of cloud at every level, as the corrections were fitted; all samples every n-th column of the year whatever its cloud, both codes taken clear-sky. near_301k gathers the cases whose global ground lies within 0.75 K of 301 K and, for each correction, the largest layer mean over land or sea among them; it holds when that is within holds_w_m2, the largest layer error the 295 K fit left in any band of latitude on its own columns. all_cases does the same over every case checked, for runs away from 301 K.
